prompt:
Convert all react native with expo:
- Core Functions and Business logic to Rust SDK.
- Rust SDK (Nuvio-core) must bind with Kotlin and Swift
- Kotlin will be used for Android Devices (Mobile and TV) using Jetcompose
- Swift using SwfitUI for Apple Devices (iOS, iPadOS and TVOS)
- Clean up all old react-native + expo code and make it solely Rust for Core, Kotlin for Android and Swift for Apple.

feature.title: Rust SDK: Core Architecture & FFI Foundation
feature.description: Establish the foundational Rust SDK (Nuvio-core) architecture including error handling, logging, configuration management, and UniFFI setup for generating Kotlin and Swift bindings. This is the base layer all other Rust SDK modules depend on.

changes.reason: Foundation layer required before all other Rust SDK modules can be properly integrated and bound to native platforms

feature.title: Rust SDK: Authentication & Session Management
feature.description: Implement user authentication, token management, session persistence, and secure credential storage in Rust core. Handles OAuth flows, JWT validation, and multi-account support.

changes.reason: Core authentication logic must be in Rust to ensure consistent security across all platforms

feature.title: Rust SDK: Streaming & Playback Coordinator
feature.description: Implement stream resolution, quality selection, buffer management coordination, and playback state machine in Rust. Provides unified playback control interface for native players.

changes.reason: Playback coordination logic is core business logic that must be centralized in Rust SDK

feature.title: Rust SDK: Kotlin Bindings Layer
feature.description: Generate and maintain Kotlin bindings from Rust SDK using UniFFI. Includes Kotlin wrapper classes, coroutine adapters for async Rust functions, and proper error type mapping for Android consumption.

changes.reason: Required bridge layer to expose Rust SDK functionality to Kotlin/Android applications

feature.title: Rust SDK: Swift Bindings Layer
feature.description: Generate and maintain Swift bindings from Rust SDK using UniFFI. Includes Swift wrapper types, async/await adapters for Rust async functions, and proper error type mapping for Apple platform consumption.

changes.reason: Required bridge layer to expose Rust SDK functionality to Swift/Apple applications

feature.title: Android App: Jetpack Compose UI (Mobile & TV)
feature.description: Build native Android application using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Implements full UI for both mobile and Android TV form factors with adaptive layouts, Leanback integration for TV, Material 3 design system, and deep integration with Rust SDK via Kotlin bindings.

changes.reason: Native Android app required to replace React Native implementation for Android Mobile and TV devices

feature.title: Apple App: SwiftUI (iOS, iPadOS, tvOS)
feature.description: Build native Apple application using Swift and SwiftUI. Implements full UI for iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV with adaptive layouts, tvOS focus engine support, and deep integration with Rust SDK via Swift bindings. Single codebase targeting all Apple platforms.

changes.reason: Native Apple app required to replace React Native implementation for iOS, iPadOS, and tvOS devices

feature.title: Android App: Media Playback Integration
feature.description: Implement ExoPlayer/Media3 integration for Android app. Includes custom player UI in Compose, picture-in-picture, background playback, Chromecast support, and coordination with Rust SDK playback state.

changes.reason: Native media playback required for Android platform with proper system integration

feature.title: Apple App: AVPlayer Integration
feature.description: Implement AVPlayer/AVKit integration for Apple app. Includes custom player UI in SwiftUI, picture-in-picture, AirPlay support, and coordination with Rust SDK playback state across iOS, iPadOS, and tvOS.

changes.reason: Native media playback required for Apple platforms with proper system integration

feature.title: React Native + Expo Codebase Removal
feature.description: Complete removal of all React Native and Expo code, dependencies, and configuration. Archive the old codebase, remove JS/TS source files, eliminate npm dependencies, and clean up any RN-specific CI/CD pipelines.

changes.reason: Clean removal of deprecated React Native codebase once native apps are production-ready

feature.description: Implement the unified search engine in Rust (Nuvio-core), aggregating and deduplicating results from TMDB, Stremio, and Trakt. Exposes async API for Kotlin/Swift bindings. This replaces the JS-side aggregation logic.

changes.reason: Updated description to reflect binding exposure requirement

feature.description: Port the AI Service (OpenRouter integration, prompt engineering, context generation) from TypeScript to Rust (Nuvio-core). Exposes streaming-capable async API for native platform consumption via Kotlin/Swift bindings.

changes.reason: Updated description to reflect binding exposure and streaming requirements

feature.description: Implement a robust download manager in Rust (Nuvio-core), handling queue state, storage allocation, encryption, expiry logic, and platform-specific storage APIs coordination for offline content on Android and Apple devices.

changes.reason: Updated description to clarify cross-platform storage coordination

feature.description: Implement the WebSocket client and synchronization state machine in Rust (Nuvio-core) to handle cross-device continue watching and watch party states. Provides callback-based API for native UI updates via Kotlin/Swift bindings.

changes.reason: Updated description to reflect callback pattern for real-time updates

feature.description: Implement efficient file system scanning, mime-type detection, and metadata matching for local media files within Rust core. Coordinates with platform-specific file access APIs on Android (SAF) and Apple (FileManager).

changes.reason: Updated description to reflect platform-specific file access requirements

feature.description: Implement the OpenSubtitles and generic subtitle provider client logic in Rust (Nuvio-core), including search, download, parsing (SRT/VTT/ASS), and subtitle synchronization. Exposes parsed subtitle data for native player rendering.

changes.reason: Updated description to clarify subtitle format support and native rendering handoff

result.summary: Complete architectural transformation from React Native + Expo to native platform apps backed by Rust SDK (Nuvio-core). Adds: (1) Core Rust architecture foundation with UniFFI bindings, (2) Authentication and Playback coordination in Rust, (3) Kotlin and Swift binding layers, (4) Native Android app with Jetpack Compose for Mobile+TV, (5) Native Apple app with SwiftUI for iOS/iPadOS/tvOS, (6) Platform-specific media player integrations, (7) React Native cleanup task. Updates all existing Rust SDK features to clarify cross-platform binding requirements and native coordination patterns.
